turns.replyText:
At Tediber, we want you to be absolutely sure about your choice. That's why we offer a 100-night trial period for our mattresses and large furniture (bed bases, sofas, etc.), starting from the day of delivery. For bed linen and mattress protectors, you have a 30-day trial period.

If you change your mind during this time, returns are completely free. The process is very simple:

For large items, a carrier will come to your home to pick up the product by appointment.
For smaller items (pillows, duvets, bed linen), we provide a prepaid return label for you to drop them off at a parcel shop.

Once the product is received at our warehouse, you will be refunded in full on your original payment method, generally within 72 hours (and no later than 15 business days).

Please note that returns cannot be handled directly in our boutiques; everything is managed through our online service.

Hello! I am Sébastien, the AI advisor at Tediber.
